definition.name: Queue Planner — Read Only
definition.description: Run Operator 5 and Operator 6 in parallel, then invoke the new deterministic Queue Planning Triage operator.

inputs.name: sla_targets
inputs.label: SLA Targets
inputs.default: VIP: 4h response / 24h resolution; Non-VIP: 8h response / 48h resolution

inputs.name: as_of
inputs.description: Reference datetime for both evidence operators.
inputs.label: As Of

inputs.name: priority_ranking_order
inputs.description: Six canonical SLA/VIP tiers, in order.
inputs.label: Priority Ranking Order
inputs.default: Breached VIP, Breached Non-VIP, At risk VIP, At risk Non-VIP, Within SLA VIP, Within SLA Non-VIP

steps.name: Queue Planner SLA Evidence
steps.description: Read-only call to Queue Planner SLA Evidence.

subworkflow_call.input_mapping_agent_prompt: Map the exact inputs for Queue Planner SLA Evidence into the namespaced payload.
subworkflow_call.output_mapping_agent_prompt: Preserve the complete output from Queue Planner SLA Evidence.
subworkflow_call.input_mapping_code_cell:
import json

async def step_sla_evidence_input_mapping():
    payload = {
        "sla_targets": user_inputs.get("sla_targets"),
        "at_risk_window_minutes": user_inputs.get("at_risk_window_minutes"),
        "default_region": user_inputs.get("default_region"),
        "as_of": user_inputs.get("as_of"),
        "issue_keys": "",
    }
    globals()["_subworkflow_inputs_step_sla_evidence"] = payload
    print(json.dumps(payload, default=str))

await step_sla_evidence_input_mapping()
subworkflow_call.output_mapping_code_cell:
import json

async def step_sla_evidence_output_mapping():
    raw = globals().get("_subworkflow_outputs_step_sla_evidence")
    if not raw:
        raise ValueError("MISSING_SLA_EVIDENCE_OUTPUT")
    globals()["sla_states_json"] = raw
    print(json.dumps(raw, default=str))

await step_sla_evidence_output_mapping()

steps.name: Queue Planning Triage
steps.description: Read-only call to Queue Planning Triage.

subworkflow_call.output_mapping_agent_prompt: Preserve the complete output from Queue Planning Triage.
subworkflow_call.input_mapping_code_cell:
import json

async def step_triage_input_mapping():
    sla = globals().get("sla_states_json")
    incidents = globals().get("incident_clusters_json")
    if not sla or not incidents:
        raise ValueError("MISSING_PLANNER_EVIDENCE")
    payload = {
        "sla_states_json": sla,
        "incident_clusters_json": incidents,
        "priority_ranking_order": user_inputs.get("priority_ranking_order"),
        "max_candidates": user_inputs.get("max_candidates"),
    }
    globals()["_subworkflow_inputs_step_triage"] = payload
    print(json.dumps(payload, default=str))

await step_triage_input_mapping()
subworkflow_call.output_mapping_code_cell:
import json

async def step_triage_output_mapping():
    raw = globals().get("_subworkflow_outputs_step_triage")
    if not raw:
        raise ValueError("MISSING_QUEUE_PLANNER_OUTPUT")
    globals()["prioritized_tickets"] = raw
    print(json.dumps(raw, default=str))

await step_triage_output_mapping()
